{{Top|leg}}
'''Disorientation syndrome''' was a condition that caused a loss of directional sense and could prevent a sufferer from being able to qualify as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. There were many possible causes of disorientation syndrome, including as the result of a rare, and incurable, disease that affected the brain stem. [[Breth Gart]] was a known sufferer, though he eventually overcame the symptoms to become a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilot for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
